newValue.title: Run: E2E Flow 2026-06-15 1029 - Implementation Roadmap
newValue.description: Complete implementation roadmap for verifying the full create-plan-roadmap-run lifecycle from UI to persisted state. Covers API Gateway, Persistence Layer, and Validation Service with modular architecture, local-only deployment, and comprehensive testing.

phases.name: Project Foundation & Infrastructure Setup
phases.goal: Establish development environment, project structure, and core infrastructure for all subsequent phases

tasks.name: Initialize Node.js project and dependencies
tasks.description: Set up package.json with Express.js, Joi for validation, Winston for logging, and Jest for testing. Configure TypeScript compilation, ESLint, and Prettier for code quality.

tasks.name: Create project directory structure
tasks.description: Establish modular folder hierarchy: /src/api, /src/persistence, /src/validation, /src/schemas, /src/middleware, /tests, /config. Define clear separation of concerns.

tasks.name: Implement centralized logging infrastructure
tasks.description: Configure Winston logger with console and file transports. Create wrapper functions for info, error, warn, debug levels. Set up request ID tracking for request-response correlation.

tasks.name: Set up error handling and exception management
tasks.description: Create custom error classes (ValidationError, PersistenceError, NotFoundError). Implement global error handler middleware. Define error response standardization.

tasks.name: Configure local file system initialization
tasks.description: Create file system directory structure for data storage (/data/plans, /data/roadmaps, /data/runs, /data/index). Implement directory initialization on app startup with idempotency.

tasks.name: Set up development server and hot reload
tasks.description: Configure Express server on port 3000. Implement nodemon for hot reload during development. Create startup script that initializes all services and logs readiness status.

phases.name: Validation Service Implementation
phases.goal: Build comprehensive JSON Schema validation service with schema registry that validates all data before persistence

tasks.name: Define core data schemas
tasks.description: Create JSON Schema definitions for Plan, Roadmap, and Run entities. Include all required fields, type definitions, constraints (min/max length, patterns), and nested object schemas. Store in /src/schemas/.

tasks.name: Implement Schema Registry
tasks.description: Create SchemaRegistry class that loads all schemas at startup, provides get/register/validate methods. Implement caching mechanism for frequently accessed schemas. Handle missing schema errors gracefully.

tasks.name: Build validation service with Joi
tasks.description: Create ValidationService that uses Joi for schema validation. Implement methods: validatePlan(), validateRoadmap(), validateRun(). Return detailed validation errors with field-level specificity.

tasks.name: Create validation middleware for Express
tasks.description: Implement middleware factory that validates request body against specified schema. Attach to routes for automatic schema validation. Log validation failures with request context.

tasks.name: Implement request/response envelope validation
tasks.description: Create standard envelope schemas for HTTP requests/responses. Validate that all API responses conform to standard structure (status, data, meta, errors). Enforce consistency across API.

tasks.name: Write comprehensive validation service tests
tasks.description: Create test suites for all validation scenarios: valid data, invalid types, missing required fields, constraint violations, edge cases. Achieve >90% code coverage for validation service.

phases.name: Persistence Layer Implementation
phases.goal: Build file-based persistence layer using repository pattern with CRUD operations, transactional consistency, and index management

tasks.name: Design repository pattern interfaces
tasks.description: Define base Repository interface with create(), read(), update(), delete(), list() methods. Create specialized PlanRepository, RoadmapRepository, RunRepository interfaces. Include transaction and atomic operation patterns.

tasks.name: Implement file-based storage abstraction
tasks.description: Create FileStorage class that handles JSON file I/O with atomic writes using temporary files. Implement read-write locking to prevent concurrent write corruption. Add error handling for disk I/O failures.

tasks.name: Implement Plan repository
tasks.description: Build PlanRepository with methods: createPlan(), getPlan(id), updatePlan(id, data), deletePlan(id), listPlans(filters). Persist plans to /data/plans/ as individual JSON files. Implement soft-delete option.

tasks.name: Implement Roadmap and Run repositories
tasks.description: Build RoadmapRepository and RunRepository following same patterns as PlanRepository. Store in /data/roadmaps/ and /data/runs/. Implement parent-child relationships and cascading operations.

tasks.name: Implement index management system
tasks.description: Create IndexManager that maintains in-memory indexes of all entities (by ID, by timestamp, by status). Rebuild indexes on startup. Auto-sync indexes on create/update/delete operations for O(1) lookups.

tasks.name: Implement transaction support and rollback
tasks.description: Create Transaction class that batches multiple operations and applies atomically. Implement rollback on failure. Add transaction log for recovery and audit trails.

tasks.name: Write persistence layer tests
tasks.description: Create comprehensive test suites for all CRUD operations, concurrent access, transaction rollback, index consistency, and failure scenarios. Mock file system failures. Achieve >85% code coverage.

phases.name: API Gateway Implementation
phases.goal: Build HTTP API endpoints that orchestrate the create-plan-roadmap-run lifecycle with proper request routing, validation, and response formatting

tasks.name: Create base API controller structure
tasks.description: Implement Controller base class with common methods (sendSuccess, sendError, getRequestContext). Create PlanController, RoadmapController, RunController classes. Implement dependency injection for repositories and validation service.

tasks.name: Implement Plan endpoints (CRUD)
tasks.description: Build endpoints: POST /api/plans (create), GET /api/plans (list), GET /api/plans/:id, PUT /api/plans/:id, DELETE /api/plans/:id. Include proper HTTP status codes and error handling.

tasks.name: Implement Roadmap endpoints with Plan integration
tasks.description: Build endpoints: POST /api/plans/:planId/roadmaps, GET /api/plans/:planId/roadmaps, GET /api/plans/:planId/roadmaps/:roadmapId, PUT, DELETE. Validate planId exists before operations.

tasks.name: Implement Run endpoints with Roadmap integration
tasks.description: Build endpoints: POST /api/plans/:planId/roadmaps/:roadmapId/runs, GET endpoints, PUT, DELETE. Validate parent resources exist. Implement Run status tracking (pending, executing, completed, failed).

tasks.name: Implement orchestration endpoints for lifecycle
tasks.description: Build composite endpoint: POST /api/flows/create-plan-roadmap-run that creates all three entities in transaction. Include rollback on partial failure. Return complete object graph in response.

tasks.name: Implement request logging and correlation middleware
tasks.description: Create middleware that logs all requests with method, path, status, duration, request ID. Correlate requests with responses and errors. Include request body/response body sampling for debugging.

tasks.name: Write API integration tests
tasks.description: Create end-to-end tests for complete lifecycle flows. Test error scenarios (missing parent, validation failure, persistence errors). Mock external dependencies. Achieve >80% API code coverage.

tasks.name: Implement health check and status endpoints
tasks.description: Build GET /health endpoint that checks all dependencies (file system, validation service). Return component statuses. Implement GET /api/status for detailed service status.

phases.name: Integration Testing & State Verification
phases.goal: Verify complete E2E lifecycle correctness, state persistence, and data consistency through comprehensive integration tests

tasks.name: Create E2E test suite for create-plan-roadmap-run flow
tasks.description: Write comprehensive test that exercises complete lifecycle: create plan, create roadmap under plan, create run under roadmap. Verify all operations succeed and return correct data structures.

tasks.name: Implement state persistence verification tests
tasks.description: Create tests that verify persisted state: restart application, query entities, confirm all data intact. Test file system state on disk. Verify index rebuilt correctly on restart.

tasks.name: Write concurrent operation tests
tasks.description: Create tests simulating concurrent requests: multiple parallel creates, updates, deletes. Verify no data corruption, race conditions, or lost updates. Test transaction isolation.

tasks.name: Implement failure scenario tests
tasks.description: Test error paths: invalid input validation, missing parent resources, disk full, file permission errors, malformed JSON. Verify proper error responses and state recovery.

tasks.name: Create data integrity validation suite
tasks.description: Implement tests that verify referential integrity (child can't exist without parent), schema compliance of persisted data, index consistency with file system state, timestamp correctness.

phases.name: UI Integration, Documentation & Deployment
phases.goal: Build simple verification UI, complete documentation, and prepare application for QA testing and local deployment

tasks.name: Create simple HTML/JS verification UI
tasks.description: Build single-page HTML interface with forms to execute create-plan-roadmap-run flow. Display responses and current state. Include buttons to test each endpoint independently. Host on /public from Express.

tasks.name: Write comprehensive API documentation
tasks.description: Document all endpoints with request/response examples. Include error codes and status meanings. Create postman collection for manual testing. Document deployment and configuration.

tasks.name: Write architecture and design documentation
tasks.description: Document component responsibilities, data flow, persistence strategy, validation approach. Include deployment diagram, component interaction diagram, and sequence diagrams for key flows.

tasks.name: Create deployment guide and startup instructions
tasks.description: Write step-by-step guide: clone repo, install dependencies, configure environment, start server, verify health check. Include troubleshooting section for common issues.

tasks.name: Final QA verification and bug fixes
tasks.description: Execute full test suite, verify all endpoints work as documented, test UI end-to-end, confirm logging is complete, check error messages are helpful. Fix any issues found.
